verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents that its Trust Center pulls monitoring checks on security controls continuously from the platform, so control status stays current without manual edits. Nothing shows subprocessor lists or document renewals syncing to the Trust Center. Vendor-list auto-detection exists, but it is not tied to Trust Center publishing. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list sync to the Trust Center, automatic document renewal/refresh on the Trust Center, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand

citations.quote: Data – like monitoring checks on security controls – is pulled continuously from Secureframe, but admins may choose to hide or display content on their Trust Center.
